title: sieve-native/form: ParseError line/col always 0 is undocumented limitation
description: crates/sieve-native/src/form.rs — the module doc explains that Token carries no source position so parse errors always report (0, 0). However ParseError::Display formats as 'parse error at 0:0: ...' which is confusing to users of the library who see a literal 0:0 position. The Display impl should either omit the location when it is (0,0) or note 'position unavailable'. The module-level comment is correct but the user-facing output is misleading.
